# Rahul Pahuja

> Principal-track Mobile Engineer specializing in mobile security architecture. Creator of the Secured Storage layer at CyberArk. 10+ years building mobile infrastructure across CyberArk, Bankwest, and Conviva.

Rahul Pahuja is a mobile engineer based in Hyderabad, India, currently Staff → Principal at CyberArk. He designs and builds security-critical mobile infrastructure: credential vaults, observability SDKs at billions-of-events scale, and digital banking platforms.

## Career

- **CyberArk** — Staff Software Engineer (2024–2025). Designed and built CyberArk's Secured Storage layer, the cryptographic foundation protecting enterprise credentials on Android and iOS (TEE-backed key storage, hardware-bound encryption, biometric unlock, secure enclave integration).
- **Coforge — Bankwest (Commonwealth Bank of Australia)** — Android & iOS Technical Lead (2024). Technical lead for Bankwest's digital banking app, used by millions of daily active users.
- **Conviva** — Senior Engineer, Android Sensors (2022–2023). Built Android/iOS observability sensors processing 12B+ metric computations per minute; owned ExoPlayer and BrightCove integrations.
- **Intellicus Technologies** — Senior Software Engineer (2019–2022). Developed the Intellicus Mobile SDK, embedded analytics and BI reporting for Android.
- **Wipro** — Unified Mobile App Developer (2014–2019). Built an award-winning travel app on Wipro's Contextual & Open Banking Platform.

## Skills

Mobile: Android, iOS, Kotlin, Swift, Jetpack Compose, UIKit, React Native, Flutter
Security: Secured Storage, TEE / Secure Enclave, Biometric Auth, Encryption, Snyk
Backend: Java, Python, Node.js, Spring Boot, Firebase, REST APIs
Infra: Jenkins, TeamCity, CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Docker
